lines: Before the injury, Nacua was the focus of the offense: 13.7 targets a game over his last 3 games, and a 43% target share against 36% for the season.
He averaged 27.3 PPR points a game over his last 3 games, up from 24.8 for the season, and played 91% of snaps in that stretch.
He is on IR, and the coach said he is out for now and starting his rehab. LA also has a bye in Wk 11.
